column2: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Audit Trail
column5:
You are on the work order detail view and can view the work order.
The work order has at least one line item.
column6:
Select “Print Work Order”, then cancel the browser print dialog without printing.
Open the audit history.
column7:
1. The “Work Order Printed” event is still logged (the system cannot detect whether the print completed from the browser dialog).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9389 (Story 6, Audit Trail) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S6-N1, read on 25 August 2026.

column1: Printing multiple times creates a separate entry each time
column2: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Audit Trail
column5:
You are on the work order detail view and can view the work order.
The work order has at least one line item.
column6:
Print the same work order three times.
Open the audit history.
column7:
1. Each print action creates a separate audit log entry.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9389 (Story 6, Audit Trail) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S6-E1, read on 25 August 2026.
